# Unpublish the portrait

Take the person's listing down.

Run `"<skill-dir>/scripts/portrait-agents" unpublish`. It deletes the listing and its jobs from the server, then removes the sign-in from this computer. Tell the person what it printed, in one line. If it fails, give its message as it is; nothing local was removed. The portrait itself stays on this computer.
